wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Imported Data"]

# Work only inside the target columns A:C.  Detect the current data extent
# from actual values in those columns, then compact rows whose Column C does
# not end with uppercase "L" from row 2 onward.
target_cols = [1, 2, 3]

last_row = 1
for row in range(ws.max_row, 0, -1):
    if any(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value is not None for col in target_cols):
        last_row = row
        break

# Capture header and all kept data rows with their styles, so the resulting
# rows retain the original per-cell values/types and formatting where possible.
kept_rows = []
for row in range(2, last_row + 1):
    cval = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value
    delete_this = isinstance(cval, str) and cval.endswith("L")
    if not delete_this:
        kept_rows.append(row)

# Store values and style-related attributes for kept rows before rewriting.
stored = []
for src_row in kept_rows:
    row_data = []
    for col in target_cols:
        cell = ws.cell(row=src_row, column=col)
        row_data.append({
            "value": cell.value,
            "style": copy.copy(cell._style),
            "number_format": cell.number_format,
            "font": copy.copy(cell.font),
            "fill": copy.copy(cell.fill),
            "border": copy.copy(cell.border),
            "alignment": copy.copy(cell.alignment),
            "protection": copy.copy(cell.protection),
        })
    stored.append(row_data)

# Clear all original data cells in rows 2:last_row within A:C, preserving only
# the header row and not touching any cells outside the allowed target range.
for row in range(2, last_row + 1):
    for col in target_cols:
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

# Rewrite compacted kept rows beginning at row 2.
dest_row = 2
for row_data in stored:
    for offset, cell_data in enumerate(row_data, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=dest_row, column=offset)
        cell.value = cell_data["value"]
        cell._style = copy.copy(cell_data["style"])
        cell.number_format = cell_data["number_format"]
        cell.font = copy.copy(cell_data["font"])
        cell.fill = copy.copy(cell_data["fill"])
        cell.border = copy.copy(cell_data["border"])
        cell.alignment = copy.copy(cell_data["alignment"])
        cell.protection = copy.copy(cell_data["protection"])
    dest_row += 1

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
